name: Relevance AI
desc: No-code teams of AI agents you deploy
desc_zh: 用无代码智能体组队干活
solves: Jobs have more than one step. Relevance AI sells the team, not the individual — several no-code agents on one assignment.
solves_zh: 一件活往往不止一步。Relevance AI 卖的是团队而不是单人：多个无代码智能体接同一件活。
best_for: Work with a team shape to it — research, drafting, checking — and no glue code.
best_for_zh: 任务本身像个小团队——调研、起草、核查——又不想写胶水代码。
